import Foundation

// Deterministic fixture generator for internal/grok/testdata/account_swift_*.json.
// Compile together with Sources/QuosparrCore/*.swift. Fake tokens only.
let out = URL(fileURLWithPath: CommandLine.arguments[1], isDirectory: true)
try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: out, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
let tmp = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("grokgen-\(UUID().uuidString)", isDirectory: true)
defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tmp) }

func str(_ d: Data) -> String { String(decoding: d, as: UTF8.self) }
func write(_ name: String, _ object: Any) throws {
    let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: object, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes])
    try data.write(to: out.appendingPathComponent(name))
}
func errName(_ e: Error) -> String {
    switch e {
    case GrokAuthDocumentError.invalidRoot: return "invalidRoot"
    case GrokAuthDocumentError.noManagedCredential: return "noManagedCredential"
    case GrokAuthDocumentError.invalidManagedCredential: return "invalidManagedCredential"
    default: return "other"
    }
}
func identityJSON(_ id: GrokCredentialIdentity) -> String {
    let enc = JSONEncoder()
    enc.outputFormatting = [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes]
    enc.dateEncodingStrategy = .grokAccountStoreDates
    return str(try! enc.encode(id))
}
let fixedNow = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_499_200.75)
let reauthProbe = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_800_000_000)

func oauth(_ body: String, scope: String = "https://auth.x.ai::desktop-client") -> String { "{\"\(scope)\":\(body)}" }

var docRows: [[String: Any]] = []
for (name, input) in docInputs {
    var row: [String: Any] = ["name": name, "input": input]
    do {
        let d = try GrokAuthDocument.parse(Data(input.utf8))
        row["ok"] = true
        row["stableID"] = d.stableID
        row["displayName"] = d.identity.resolvedDisplayName
        row["scopes"] = d.managedScopeKeys
        row["identity"] = identityJSON(d.identity)
        row["requiresReauth"] = d.requiresReauthentication(at: reauthProbe)
        if let at = try? d.accessToken() { row["accessToken"] = at }
        if let rt = try? d.refreshToken() { row["refreshToken"] = rt }
        row["refreshed"] = (try? str(GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(
            to: Data(input.utf8), accessToken: " new-access ", refreshToken: " new-refresh ", expiresIn: 3600, now: fixedNow))) ?? "ERR"
        row["refreshedNoRotation"] = (try? str(GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(
            to: Data(input.utf8), accessToken: "a2", refreshToken: nil, expiresIn: nil, now: fixedNow))) ?? "ERR"
        row["refreshedBlankRefresh"] = (try? str(GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(
            to: Data(input.utf8), accessToken: "a3", refreshToken: "  ", expiresIn: 0, now: fixedNow))) ?? "ERR"
    } catch {
        row["ok"] = false
        row["error"] = errName(error)
    }
    docRows.append(row)
}
// Token refresh edge errors.
var refreshErrors: [[String: Any]] = []
for (name, input) in [("oauth_full", docInputs[0].1)] {
    do { _ = try GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(to: Data(input.utf8), accessToken: "   ", refreshToken: nil, expiresIn: nil, now: fixedNow); refreshErrors.append(["name": name, "error": "none"]) }
    catch { refreshErrors.append(["name": name, "error": errName(error)]) }
}
try write("account_swift_documents.json", ["rows": docRows, "refreshErrors": refreshErrors])

// 2. Layout probe: key order, slashes, numbers, nesting, unicode, escapes.
let layoutInput = #"""
{"https://auth.x.ai::desktop-client":{"key":"k","user_id":"u","zeta":1,"Alpha":2,"alpha":3,"_under":4,"Ünï":5,"日本":6,"path":"a/b\/c","nested":{"b":[1,2.5,{"y":null,"X":true}],"a":{}},"emptyArr":[],"num":[1.0,0.10,1e3,-0,12345678901234567890,3.14159],"esc":"q\"uote\\back\nnl\ttab\u0001ctl","uni":"é😀 x","slash2":"https:\/\/x.ai"},"xai::api_key":{"key":"api","Z":1,"a":2}}
"""#
var layoutRows: [[String: Any]] = []
do {
    let official = layoutInput
    let target = oauth(#"{"email":"t@x.ai","key":"tk","user_id":"tu","Beta":[3,2,1],"x/y":"p/q"}"#)
    layoutRows.append(["name": "merge_full", "official": official, "target": target,
        "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.replacingManagedScopes(in: Data(official.utf8), with: Data(target.utf8)))])
    layoutRows.append(["name": "merge_nil_official", "target": target,
        "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.replacingManagedScopes(in: nil, with: Data(target.utf8)))])
    layoutRows.append(["name": "refresh_layout",  "official": official,
        "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(to: Data(official.utf8), accessToken: "na", refreshToken: "nr", expiresIn: 60, now: fixedNow))])
    // target with legacy + oauth + api key: only the chosen managed scope is copied.
    let multi = #"{"https://accounts.x.ai/sign-in":{"email":"l@x.ai","key":"k","user_id":"lu"},"https://auth.x.ai::bb":{"email":"b@x.ai","key":"kb","user_id":"bu"},"xai::api_key":{"key":"target-api"}}"#
    let official2 = #"{"https://auth.x.ai::old":{"email":"o@x.ai","key":"ko","user_id":"ou"},"xai::api_key":{"key":"official-api"},"https://idp.example.com::c":{"key":"custom","user_id":"cu"},"https://accounts.x.ai/sign-in":{"key":"oldlegacy","user_id":"x"}}"#
    layoutRows.append(["name": "merge_multi", "official": official2, "target": multi,
        "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.replacingManagedScopes(in: Data(official2.utf8), with: Data(multi.utf8)))])
    let apiOnly = #"{"xai::api_key":{"key":"official-api"}}"#
    layoutRows.append(["name": "merge_api_only_official", "official": apiOnly, "target": multi,
        "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.replacingManagedScopes(in: Data(apiOnly.utf8), with: Data(multi.utf8)))])
}
// Escapes, number forms and key ordering.
let probe1 = #"{"https://auth.x.ai::desktop-client":{"key":"k","user_id":"u","e1":"b\bf\fl\u001fv\u000bd\u007fz\u0000n\u00e9\ud83d\ude00\u2029 \r","n":[1e20,1E-7,0.000001,123456789.123456789,-1.5e300,5e-324,100000000000000000000,9223372036854775807,9223372036854775808,-9223372036854775808,-9223372036854775809,18446744073709551615,18446744073709551616,0.5,100,1.0e2,1E2,-0.0,2e0,0.1e1,123456789012345678]}}"#

    "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(to: Data(probe1.utf8), accessToken: "na", refreshToken: nil, expiresIn: nil, now: fixedNow))])
var keys = ["a-b", "a_b", "a b", "a.b", "a/b", "a:b", "a1", "a2", "a10", "A", "b", "B", "aB", "Ab", "ab", "AB", "a", "_", "-", ".", "0", "9", "Z", "z", "é", "e", "f", "E", "ÿ", "y", "z1", "Ω", "ω", "я", "ä", "a~", "a!", "a@", "a#", "a$", "a%", "a^", "a&", "a*", "a(", "a+", "a=", "a|", "a?", "a,", "a;", "a'", "a\"", "a<", "a`", "key2", "key_2", "key-2", "Key", "KEY", "keys", "ǆ", "ß", "ss", "ﬁ", "fi", "ø", "o", "p", "œ", "oe", "æ", "ae", "å", "aa"]
var objParts: [String] = []
for (i, k) in keys.enumerated() {
    let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: [k], options: [])
    let arr = str(data); let lit = String(arr.dropFirst().dropLast())
    objParts.append("\(lit):\(i)")
}
let probe2 = "{\"https://auth.x.ai::desktop-client\":{\"key\":\"k\",\"user_id\":\"u\"," + objParts.joined(separator: ",") + "}}"
layoutRows.append(["name": "key_order", "official": probe2,
    "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(to: Data(probe2.utf8), accessToken: "na", refreshToken: nil, expiresIn: nil, now: fixedNow))])
// Top-level (scope) key order.
let probe3 = #"{"xai::api_key":{"key":"a"},"https://auth.x.ai::zeta":{"key":"k","user_id":"u"},"https://auth.x.ai::Alpha":{"key":"k","user_id":"u2"},"Https://x":{"a":1},"_x":{},"1":[]}"#
layoutRows.append(["name": "scope_order", "official": probe3,
    "out": str(try GrokAuthDocument.applyingTokenRefresh(to: Data(probe3.utf8), accessToken: "na", refreshToken: nil, expiresIn: nil, now: fixedNow))])
try write("account_swift_layout.json", layoutRows)

// 3. Paste importer.
let pastes: [(String, String)] = [

    ("array_dupes", #"[{"email":"one@example.com","key":"a1","user_id":"u1"},{"email":"one@example.com","key":"a1b","user_id":"u1"}]"#),
    ("notes", "here is my grok auth:\n{\"email\":\"notes@example.com\",\"key\":\"nk\",\"user_id\":\"nu\",\"refresh_token\":\"nr\"}\nthanks"),
    ("ndjson", "{\"email\":\"l1@example.com\",\"key\":\"k1\",\"user_id\":\"u1\"}\n{\"email\":\"l2@example.com\",\"key\":\"k2\",\"user_id\":\"u2\"}\nnot json\n"),

    ("token_only", #"{"key":"token-only-no-identity"}"#),
    ("empty", "   "),

    ("nested_authroot_in_array", "[" + oauth(#"{"key":"k","user_id":"na"}"#) + "]"),
    ("unicode_slash", #"{"email":"é@example.com","key":"a/b","user_id":"uni","team_name":"日本"}"#),
]
var pasteRows: [[String: Any]] = []
for (name, text) in pastes {
    let payloads = GrokAccountImporter().parsePayloads(from: text)
    pasteRows.append(["name": name, "text": text, "payloads": payloads.map(str)])
}
try write("account_swift_paste.json", pasteRows)

// 4. OAuth auth document.
var oauthRows: [[String: Any]] = []
func bundle(_ access: String, _ refresh: String, _ expires: Int?, _ email: String?, _ subject: String?) -> GrokOAuthLogin.TokenBundle {
    .init(accessToken: access, refreshToken: refresh, idToken: nil, tokenType: nil, expiresIn: expires, email: email, subject: subject,
          tokenEndpoint: URL(string: "https://auth.x.ai/oauth2/token")!)
}
let bundles: [(String, GrokOAuthLogin.TokenBundle)] = [
    ("full", bundle("acc", "ref", 3600, "Device@Example.com", "sub-1")),
    ("email_only", bundle("acc", "ref", 3600, "Mail@Example.com", nil)),
    ("subject_only", bundle("acc", "", nil, nil, "sub-2")),
    ("no_refresh_zero_expiry", bundle("acc", "", 0, "z@example.com", "sub-3")),
    ("padded", bundle("acc", "ref", nil, "  pad@example.com ", " sub-4 ")),
    ("none", bundle("acc", "ref", nil, nil, nil)),
    ("blank", bundle("acc", "ref", nil, "   ", "  ")),
]
for (name, b) in bundles {
    do {
        let d = try GrokOAuthLogin.makeAuthDocumentData(tokens: b, now: fixedNow)
        oauthRows.append(["name": name, "out": str(d), "stableID": try GrokAuthDocument.parse(d).stableID])
    } catch { oauthRows.append(["name": name, "error": "\(error)"]) }
}
try write("account_swift_oauth.json", oauthRows)

// 5. Store sequence: index, credentials, pack, preview ids.
func cred(_ email: String, _ user: String, access: String = "tok-access", refresh: String = "tok-refresh", team: String? = nil, expires: String = "2099-08-01T12:00:00Z") -> Data {
    var body: [String: Any] = ["auth_mode": "oidc", "create_time": "2026-07-30T12:00:00Z", "email": email, "expires_at": expires,
        "key": access, "oidc_client_id": "desktop-client", "oidc_issuer": "https://auth.x.ai", "principal_id": "principal-\(user)",
        "principal_type": "User", "refresh_token": refresh, "user_id": user, "x_extra": ["keep": "me/too", "n": 1]]
    if let team { body["team_id"] = team; body["team_name"] = "Team \(team)" }
    return try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ["https://auth.x.ai::desktop-client": body], options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes])
}
let store = GrokAccountStore(rootURL: tmp.appendingPathComponent("accounts"), officialHomeURL: tmp.appendingPathComponent("official"))
let t0 = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_499_200.1235)
let c1 = cred("Zed@example.com", "user-z")
let c2 = cred("alpha@example.com", "user-a", team: "T-9")
let c3 = Data(#"{"https://accounts.x.ai/sign-in":{"auth_mode":"grok","email":"legacy@example.com","key":"lk","user_id":"user-l"}}"#.utf8)
let a1 = try store.upsertCredentialData(c1, makeCurrent: true, now: t0)
let a2 = try store.upsertCredentialData(c2, makeCurrent: false, now: t0.addingTimeInterval(60))
let a3 = try store.upsertCredentialData(c3, makeCurrent: false, now: t0.addingTimeInterval(120))
// Rotation of a1 (same identity) keeps id/sort/created.
let c1b = cred("Zed@example.com", "user-z", access: "tok-access-2", refresh: "tok-refresh-2")
_ = try store.upsertCredentialData(c1b, makeCurrent: false, now: t0.addingTimeInterval(180))
var m2 = try store.loadIndex().account(id: a2.id)!
m2.alias = "Alpha / \u{00e9}"
m2 = m2.applying(snapshot: GrokQuotaSnapshot(
    plan: "SuperGrok", includedUsagePercent: 42.25,
    period: GrokQuotaPeriod(kind: .weekly, startsAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_000_000), resetsAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_600_000.5)),
    includedLimitCents: 10_000, includedUsedCents: 4_225, prepaidBalanceCents: 500, onDemandEnabled: false,
    onDemandUsedCents: nil, onDemandLimitCents: nil,
    productUsage: [GrokProductUsage(product: "GrokBuild", usagePercent: 12.5)],
    isUnifiedBillingUser: true, source: .current, updatedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_499_500.25)))
try store.updateMetadata(m2)
var m3 = try store.loadIndex().account(id: a3.id)!
m3 = m3.applying(error: "authentication_required", requiresReauth: true)
try store.updateMetadata(m3)
try store.reorder(ids: [a3.id, a1.id])
try store.setCurrentAccountID(a2.id, lastUsedAt: t0.addingTimeInterval(300))
let storeIndex = try String(contentsOf: store.indexURL, encoding: .utf8)
let exp = try GrokAccountExporter(store: store, appVersion: "0.0.87").export(accountIDs: [a1.id, a2.id, a3.id, "missing"], now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_785_500_000.5))
let packData = try AccountTransferCodec.encode(exp.pack)
let ordered = try store.loadIndex().orderedAccounts().map(\.id)
let preview = GrokAccountTransferImporter(store: store).previewFiles(at: [])
var packFile = tmp.appendingPathComponent("pack.json")
try packData.write(to: packFile)
let previewPack = GrokAccountTransferImporter(store: store).previewFiles(at: [packFile])
// Preview against an empty store: ids and conflicts.
let emptyStore = GrokAccountStore(rootURL: tmp.appendingPathComponent("accounts2"), officialHomeURL: tmp.appendingPathComponent("official2"))
let previewEmpty = GrokAccountTransferImporter(store: emptyStore).previewFiles(at: [packFile])
func describe(_ p: GrokAccountImportPreview) -> [String: Any] {
    ["failures": p.failures, "sourceIsPack": p.sourceIsPack,
     "items": p.items.map { item -> [String: Any] in
        var conflict = "willAdd"; var existing = ""
        if case let .willUpdate(name) = item.preview.conflict { conflict = "willUpdate"; existing = name }
        return ["id": item.preview.id, "displayName": item.preview.displayName, "detail": item.preview.detail ?? "",
                "conflict": conflict, "existing": existing, "alias": item.alias ?? "", "credential": str(item.credentialData)] }]
}
// Paste text file preview.
let pasteFile = tmp.appendingPathComponent("paste.txt")
try Data("{\"email\":\"p1@example.com\",\"key\":\"k1\",\"user_id\":\"u1\"}\n{\"email\":\"p2@example.com\",\"key\":\"k2\",\"user_id\":\"u2\"}".utf8).write(to: pasteFile)
